entities.name: YagG P75683
observations: Reviewed E. coli K-12 protein; input sequence is an exact full-length match (460 aa).
Annotated as a putative glycoside/cation symporter; GO annotations associate it with symporter activity, carbohydrate transport, sodium-ion transport, and transmembrane transport.
Annotated localization is the cell inner membrane; sequence has MFS_2 and MFS_1 Pfam domains (positions 11–430 and 19–376).
